Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints
of low back strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported severity of
the crash, and the symptom pattern fits a soft-tissue strain of the lumbar region. Over
the course of 18 visits, care included manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home
exercise program. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency
tapering as pain and mobility improved. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness
and reduced lumbar range of motion were noted and support the diagnosis, while
neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and straight-leg raise,
returned normal results. The patient reports a prior mild strain in the same region
several years earlier, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation. Billing
records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service with no duplicate or
repeated entries. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and activity as
tolerated.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
